It is formed by a dam constructed in 1963 with a hydroelectric complex producing 20 megawatts of power.  The surface area of the reservoir is about 33 km². The name originates from the nearby Zegrze village, featuring the historic Radziwiłł Palace (Pałac Zegrzyński) built in 1847 by the noble Krasiński family.
